PolicyCondition.description: Typed dictionary schema for a single compound policy condition clause.

field.description: File or document target inspected by this clause: 'name' (basename), 'extension' (file suffix), 'content' (extracted text), 'path' (relative/full path), or 'any_text' (basename, path, or extracted text).
field.title: Field

operator.description: Comparison operator applied to the target field: 'contains', 'equals', 'starts_with', 'ends_with', 'glob' wildcard matching, or bounded 'regex'.
operator.title: Operator

value.description: Non-empty string, wildcard mask, or bounded regular expression (<= 256 chars) to match.
value.title: Value

negate.description: When true, invert this individual condition clause's match result.
negate.title: Negate

case_sensitive.description: When true, preserve character casing when evaluating this condition clause.
case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive

PolicyCondition.title: PolicyCondition

PolicyConditionGroup.description: Typed dictionary schema for a nested boolean condition group within a PolicyRule.

match_mode.description: Boolean combinator applied across nested clauses: 'all' (AND), 'any' (OR), or 'none' (NOR).
match_mode.title: Match Mode

conditions.description: Non-empty list of leaf PolicyCondition clauses evaluated under match_mode.
conditions.title: Conditions

negate.description: When true, invert the boolean outcome of this nested condition group.
negate.title: Negate

PolicyConditionGroup.title: PolicyConditionGroup

PolicyRule.description: Typed dictionary schema for unified compliance and routing policy rules.

type.description: Rule evaluation strategy: 'keyword', 'action', 'compliance', or 'unarchive' match filenames and document text; 'pattern' matches lowercase filenames only; 'override' matches lowercase filenames or full file paths; 'duplicate' matches byte-verified duplicate files; 'age', 'modified_date', 'created_date', 'exif_date', and 'size' evaluate file timestamps, EXIF/PDF headers, and byte sizes.
type.title: Type

expression.description: Non-empty case-insensitive substring, wildcard/regex pattern, metadata comparison expression (such as '> 30d', '< 2025-01-01', or '> 10MB'), or readable summary of compound conditions.
expression.title: Expression

target_path.description: Relative destination folder path (supporting optional placeholders such as '{year}/{month}', '{date}', '{day}', '{category}', '{seq}', '{extension}', and '{stem}') validated against path safety rules (no leading slashes, '..' traversal segments, OS-reserved device names, illegal path characters, or trailing spaces/periods; may be empty when an action handles placement).
target_path.title: Target Path

priority.description: Integer evaluation priority; rules execute sequentially from highest priority to lowest.
priority.title: Priority

match_mode.description: Optional boolean combinator for compound 'conditions' (or single-clause 'none' inversion): 'all' (every clause must match), 'any' (at least one clause must match), or 'none' (no clause may match).
match_mode.title: Match Mode

conditions.description: Optional compound boolean condition tree (capped at 2 nesting levels and 32 total clauses per PolicyRule).
conditions.title: Conditions

negate.description: When true, invert the overall match result of this policy rule.
negate.title: Negate

regex.description: When true, evaluate 'expression' as a bounded ReDoS-safe regular expression (<= 256 characters, rejecting nested quantifiers).
regex.title: Regex

case_sensitive.description: When true, preserve character casing during policy evaluation.
case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive

halting.description: When true, stop evaluating lower-priority rules immediately if this rule does not match.
halting.title: Halting

enabled.description: Whether this policy rule is active during evaluation (defaults to true when omitted).
enabled.title: Enabled

rename_pattern.description: Optional filename rename template applied when this policy matches (supports {date}, {year}, {month}, {day}, {category}, {seq}, {sequence}, {extension}, {stem}, and {original} placeholders).
rename_pattern.title: Rename Pattern

action.description: Optional lifecycle directive executed when the policy matches.
action.title: Action

detect_original_by.description: Optional original-file selection mode for 'duplicate' policy rules ('first_seen', 'name', 'created', 'lastmodified', or '-' reverse variants).
detect_original_by.title: Detect Original By

post_unarchive_action.description: Source archive handling after 'unarchive' extraction: delete ('delete', 'remove', 'cleanup'), relocate ('move', 'archive', 'relocate'), or keep in place ('retain', 'keep'). Legacy aliases 'post_action' and 'archive_action' are also accepted when loading settings.json.
post_unarchive_action.title: Post Unarchive Action

PolicyRule.title: PolicyRule

CONTEXTUAL_RENAMING.description: Whether to rename sorted files using extracted document context and dates during plan generation.
CONTEXTUAL_RENAMING.title: Contextual Renaming

AI_ASSISTED_NAMING.description: Whether to use local semantic embeddings and/or the generative LLM model to synthesize descriptive folder and file names (requires AI consent and the optional 'ml' extra).
AI_ASSISTED_NAMING.title: Ai Assisted Naming

RENAME_PATTERN.description: Optional default rename pattern template combining extracted document or file dates with descriptive terms (for example '{date}_{stem}'; supports {date}, {year}, {month}, {day}, {category}, {seq}, {sequence}, {extension}, {stem}, and {original} placeholders).
RENAME_PATTERN.title: Rename Pattern

PRESERVE_HIERARCHY.description: Whether to retain relative source subfolder structure beneath generated destination category directories.
PRESERVE_HIERARCHY.title: Preserve Hierarchy

SCAN_MAX_DEPTH.description: Maximum subfolder recursion depth when scanning directories (integer from 0 to 20 levels; 0 scans top-level files only).
SCAN_MAX_DEPTH.title: Scan Max Depth

MAX_FOLDERS.description: Maximum number of category folders generated per clustering level (integer from 1 to 50 folders).
MAX_FOLDERS.title: Max Folders

MAX_WORKERS.description: Maximum number of concurrent worker threads or processes used for file extraction and move operations (integer from 1 to 64 workers).
MAX_WORKERS.title: Max Workers

MAX_DEPTH.description: Maximum directory recursion depth for hierarchical clustering and folder generation (integer from 1 to 10 levels).
MAX_DEPTH.title: Max Depth

MAX_FEATURES.description: Maximum number of top TF-IDF keyword terms combined when naming generated cluster folders (integer from 1 to 10 terms).
MAX_FEATURES.title: Max Features

CLEANUP_EMPTY_FOLDERS.description: Whether to automatically remove empty source subdirectories after file moves complete.
CLEANUP_EMPTY_FOLDERS.title: Cleanup Empty Folders

SPEAK_ANNOUNCEMENTS.description: Whether to emit spoken accessibility announcements in the terminal UI when screen-reader feedback is enabled.
SPEAK_ANNOUNCEMENTS.title: Speak Announcements

ENABLE_CHARACTER_KEY_SHORTCUTS.description: Whether single-character keyboard shortcuts (such as 'R' to reassign) are active in the terminal UI when text inputs are not focused.
ENABLE_CHARACTER_KEY_SHORTCUTS.title: Enable Character Key Shortcuts

KEYWORD_RULES.description: Mapping of lowercase keyword strings to relative target folder paths. Target paths are validated to forbid absolute paths, '..' traversal segments, OS-reserved device names, illegal characters (<, >, :, ", |, ?, *), and trailing spaces or periods.
KEYWORD_RULES.title: Keyword Rules

DISABLED_KEYWORD_RULES.description: Mapping of temporarily disabled keyword strings to relative target folder paths, preserving path mappings while inactive and enforcing the same relative target path validation as KEYWORD_RULES.
DISABLED_KEYWORD_RULES.title: Disabled Keyword Rules

LEARNED_RULES.description: Mapping of user-corrected keyword patterns to relative target folder paths learned from interactive reassignments, validated with the same relative path rules as KEYWORD_RULES.
LEARNED_RULES.title: Learned Rules

EXTENSION_CATEGORIES.description: Custom mapping of category folder names to lists of file extensions or extension overrides used for fallback file-type routing.
EXTENSION_CATEGORIES.title: Extension Categories

POLICIES.description: Ordered list of typed PolicyRule dictionaries evaluated from highest integer priority to lowest across 12 rule types ('keyword', 'pattern', 'override', 'action', 'compliance', 'unarchive', 'duplicate', 'age', 'modified_date', 'created_date', 'exif_date', 'size'), optional rename_pattern templates, 6 lifecycle actions ('archive', 'retain', 'quarantine', 'redact', 'unarchive', 'trash'), and 8 post-unarchive actions; warns when higher-priority rules shadow lower-priority rules.
POLICIES.title: Policies

VISUAL_TIMEOUT.description: Per-file timeout in seconds (> 0) for visual OCR and vision model extraction before aborting visual analysis on a document.
VISUAL_TIMEOUT.title: Visual Timeout

IMAGE_MAX_DIMENSION.description: Maximum width or height in pixels (> 0) to which images are downscaled while preserving aspect ratio prior to OCR or vision inference.
IMAGE_MAX_DIMENSION.title: Image Max Dimension

IMAGE_SKIP_THRESHOLD.description: Dimension threshold in pixels (> 0) above which oversized images trigger pre-processing downscaling or fast-path handling.
IMAGE_SKIP_THRESHOLD.title: Image Skip Threshold

PDF_TEXT_DENSITY_THRESHOLD.description: Minimum average extracted character count per PDF page (>= 0 characters) below which a PDF is treated as scanned and routed to OCR fallback.
PDF_TEXT_DENSITY_THRESHOLD.title: Pdf Text Density Threshold

MODEL_THREADS.description: Number of CPU threads allocated per local ML/ONNX/GGUF model inference worker (integer from 1 to 32 threads).
MODEL_THREADS.title: Model Threads

GRAMMAR_CACHE_SIZE.description: Maximum number of compiled GBNF grammar definitions cached in memory for constrained generative naming (integer from 1 to 256 entries).
GRAMMAR_CACHE_SIZE.title: Grammar Cache Size

SNAPSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Number of days (> 0) to retain historical sorting session records and rollback snapshots before automatic pruning.
SNAPSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS.title: Snapshot Retention Days

PROTECTED_PATHS.description: List of absolute literal directory paths protected from scanning, moving, or modification. Relative paths and wildcard or glob characters ('*', '?', '[', ']') are rejected.
PROTECTED_PATHS.title: Protected Paths

AUTO_QUARANTINE_RATINGS.description: Opt-in sensitivity severity ratings (such as 'CRITICAL' and 'HIGH') that automatically route detected files into compliance quarantine staging. Defaults to an empty list so automatic sensitivity quarantine is disabled until enabled.
AUTO_QUARANTINE_RATINGS.title: Auto Quarantine Ratings

QUARANTINE_DIR_NAME.description: Directory name created inside the workspace for staging quarantined compliance files.
QUARANTINE_DIR_NAME.title: Quarantine Dir Name

PROXY.description: Outbound network proxy URI used for model downloads and security advisory checks. Kept cleartext in memory during runtime, encrypted at rest in settings.json with an 'enc:' prefix (auto-migrating legacy plaintext values), and replaced with '<DECRYPTION_FAILED>' in memory if decryption fails without overwriting persisted ciphertext.
PROXY.title: Proxy

SECURITY_ADVISORY_ENDPOINT.description: HTTPS endpoint queried for model repository security metadata and published advisories before downloading or loading weights (defaults to Hugging Face Hub models API; supports custom HTTPS mirrors).
SECURITY_ADVISORY_ENDPOINT.title: Security Advisory Endpoint

TRUSTED_MODEL_HOSTS.description: Additional trusted HTTPS hostnames permitted for model downloads and security advisory mirror queries alongside 'huggingface.co' and 'hf.co'. IP literals, private or loopback addresses, and non-HTTPS schemes remain blocked.
TRUSTED_MODEL_HOSTS.title: Trusted Model Hosts

SECURITY_ADVISORY_CACHE_TTL.description: Time-to-live in seconds (>= 1 second) for cached security advisory responses before re-querying the advisory endpoint.
SECURITY_ADVISORY_CACHE_TTL.title: Security Advisory Cache Ttl

SECURITY_ADVISORY_FALLBACK_POLICY.description: Fallback behavior when the security advisory endpoint is unreachable: 'strict' refuses to load unverified models, whereas 'permissive' allows loading.
SECURITY_ADVISORY_FALLBACK_POLICY.title: Security Advisory Fallback Policy

OCR_GPU_ENABLED.description: Whether to enable GPU hardware acceleration for EasyOCR and vision extraction workloads when a compatible accelerator is available.
OCR_GPU_ENABLED.title: Ocr Gpu Enabled

AUDIO_GPU_ENABLED.description: Whether to enable GPU hardware acceleration for Whisper audio transcription workloads.
AUDIO_GPU_ENABLED.title: Audio Gpu Enabled

AUDIO_MAX_WORKERS.description: Maximum number of concurrent worker processes dedicated to audio transcription tasks (integer from 1 to 64 workers; aliased as MAX_AUDIO_WORKERS).
AUDIO_MAX_WORKERS.title: Audio Max Workers

PLUGINS.description: List of enabled plugin Python module identifiers. Entries must be valid dotted Python identifiers without path or shell characters; explicit dotted module paths must start with 'app.plugins.' or 'sortify_plugin_', and Python standard library or system modules are forbidden.
PLUGINS.title: Plugins

OCR_LANGUAGES.description: Comma-separated list of non-empty OCR language codes (alphanumeric characters and underscores only, such as 'en' or 'ch_sim,en').
OCR_LANGUAGES.title: Ocr Languages

VISION_ENGINE.description: Visual text and caption extraction backend: 'easyocr' for standard OCR or 'florence-2' for vision-language document understanding.
VISION_ENGINE.title: Vision Engine

CONFLICT_POLICY.description: Resolution strategy when a destination file already exists: 'skip' leaves the source untouched, 'rename' appends a numeric suffix, and 'overwrite' replaces the target.
CONFLICT_POLICY.title: Conflict Policy

MOVE_ERROR_POLICY.description: Failure handling policy during physical file moves: 'rollback' unwinds the entire batch atomically on error (headless/CLI default), while 'partial_commit' preserves verified moves and records failed items for targeted retry.
MOVE_ERROR_POLICY.title: Move Error Policy

DUPLICATE_ACTION.description: Handling mode for exact byte-identical duplicate clusters during scan and sort: 'off' treats copies normally, 'review' prompts in interactive TUI, 'skip' excludes redundant copies, 'stage' displaces copies into .sortify_duplicates/<session_id>/ for undo, and 'trash' stages verified copies for OS Trash disposal.
DUPLICATE_ACTION.title: Duplicate Action

DETECT_ORIGINAL_BY.description: Selector used to choose the surviving original file in each byte-identical duplicate cluster ('first_seen', 'name', 'created', 'lastmodified', or '-' reverse order variants).
DETECT_ORIGINAL_BY.title: Detect Original By

SORTING_STRATEGY.description: Document clustering and taxonomy strategy identifier (for example 'default' TF-IDF/embedding clustering, 'generative', 'clinical_tmf', or 'clinical_isf').
SORTING_STRATEGY.title: Sorting Strategy

CLINICAL_SMART_RENAMING.description: Whether clinical sorting strategies standardize filenames using Trial Master File (TMF/ISF) study, artifact, and date metadata.
CLINICAL_SMART_RENAMING.title: Clinical Smart Renaming

CLINICAL_GENERATE_AUDIT_REPORT.description: Whether clinical compliance runs automatically generate a regulatory audit trail report upon completion.
CLINICAL_GENERATE_AUDIT_REPORT.title: Clinical Generate Audit Report

CLINICAL_SUPPRESS_DUPLICATES.description: Whether clinical multi-study ingestion skips copying byte-verified duplicate artifacts instead of creating numbered _1 copies while preserving manifest lineage.
CLINICAL_SUPPRESS_DUPLICATES.title: Clinical Suppress Duplicates

COHERENCE_THRESHOLD.description: Minimum semantic similarity coherence score (float from 0.0 to 1.0) required to group documents into a topic cluster before falling back to Miscellaneous.
COHERENCE_THRESHOLD.title: Coherence Threshold

DEBOUNCE_DELAY.description: Initial filesystem event debounce delay in seconds (> 0.0 and must be <= MAX_DEBOUNCE_DELAY) before the background daemon processes newly modified files.
DEBOUNCE_DELAY.title: Debounce Delay

MAX_DEBOUNCE_DELAY.description: Maximum ceiling in seconds (> 0.0 and must be >= DEBOUNCE_DELAY) that bursty filesystem events can defer daemon batch processing.
MAX_DEBOUNCE_DELAY.title: Max Debounce Delay

MAX_QUEUE_CAPACITY.description: Maximum number of pending filesystem events (> 0 items) buffered in the background daemon priority queue before backpressure applies.
MAX_QUEUE_CAPACITY.title: Max Queue Capacity

DEDUP_WINDOW.description: Time window in seconds (>= 0.0 seconds) used by the daemon watcher to coalesce duplicate filesystem events for the same path.
DEDUP_WINDOW.title: Dedup Window

RECONCILIATION_INTERVAL.description: Periodic interval in seconds (> 0.0 seconds) between background daemon sweeps for missed files and incomplete ledger transactions.
RECONCILIATION_INTERVAL.title: Reconciliation Interval

WORKER_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum execution time in seconds (>= 0.0 seconds) allowed for background extraction, clustering, or forensic quarantine scan workers before timing out.
WORKER_TIMEOUT.title: Worker Timeout

TABULAR_MAX_SHEETS.description: Maximum number of workbook sheets (> 0 sheets) sampled per spreadsheet during tabular text extraction (aliased as MAX_SPREADSHEET_SHEETS).
TABULAR_MAX_SHEETS.title: Tabular Max Sheets

TABULAR_MAX_ROWS.description: Maximum number of rows (> 0 rows) read per sheet or CSV file during tabular text extraction (aliased as MAX_SPREADSHEET_ROWS).
TABULAR_MAX_ROWS.title: Tabular Max Rows

TABULAR_MAX_CHARACTERS.description: Maximum total extracted character budget (> 0 characters) retained per tabular document (aliased as MAX_SPREADSHEET_CHARACTERS).
TABULAR_MAX_CHARACTERS.title: Tabular Max Characters

IGNORED_EXTENSIONS.description: List of temporary or incomplete file extensions skipped during scanning and daemon watching (non-empty strings normalized with a leading '.', such as '.tmp').
IGNORED_EXTENSIONS.title: Ignored Extensions

AI_CONSENT_GRANTED.description: User consent state for local AI model downloads and semantic vector indexing: true (granted), false (declined; unloads models and scrubs vectors), or null (not yet prompted).
AI_CONSENT_GRANTED.title: Ai Consent Granted

LOG_FILE.description: Filesystem path to the primary rotating application log file (non-empty string; defaults to 'autosorter.log' inside the app directory).
LOG_FILE.title: Log File

STOP_WORDS.description: Set of common noise and file-extension tokens excluded during TF-IDF keyword extraction and cluster folder naming.
STOP_WORDS.title: Stop Words
